cycles_exitance.method: Cycles vertex-colour (face-corner) bake of the DIFFUSE pass, direct + colour (Cycles 3.x merges subsurface into diffuse), on the Lego object of lego_b4_T0_s1.blend with one sun (held-out T0 view 6 light, strength E_SUN), world black, other lights off; Lego Yellow exit flux = sum over Yellow triangles of pi * area * mean corner radiance (isotropic exit)
cycles_exitance.denominators: incident sun power on Yellow ports (sum A E_sun) and on all Lego ports; the injected power (0.98 SSS weight x incident on Yellow) is reported separately; no 'absorbed' claim
cycles_exitance.validity: replicate seed; valid if the replicate total differs < 3 %; budget: one smoke + at most 2 bakes, <= 30 CPU-min; else INCONCLUSIVE
cycles_exitance.does_not_change: the passivity contract and every gate

conditions.A0: worklog-48 ideal-weight quadrature on K44's representative lists: band 96 reps x cell-average kernel over r < 5 cm x nbrA / member area; mid 128 reps x cell-average over 5 <= r < 30 cm x midA / member area
conditions.A1: RELAXED capacity control on the SAME features (area-mean irradiance of the 96 band reps and 128 mid reps, per receiver, 224 per channel): per-receiver least squares on the fit fields (ridge 1e-6 x trace / dim, no sweep). More freedom than K44 (per-receiver free weights), not an achievable K44 bound. The 19-bin incident split of hB is not used (worklog 47: Yellow response angle-insensitive)
conditions.A1g: A1 + 64 global features (field projected on the top-64 principal components of the fit fields' area-weighted irradiance) - can a global term compensate in-support loss
conditions.A2: source-resolved exact in-support kernel (error 0 by definition; the reference)
conditions.collision: P E = area-mean of E over the atoms (band aggregate x mid cell intersections): identical band and mid aggregate features for EVERY receiver; e_coll = ||y_S30(E) - y_S30(PE)|| / ||y_S30(E)||; any function of the existing features returns the same output for E and PE

gate1.primary_metric: relative L2 of y_S30 over shadow receivers, pooled over the test fields, per channel; also lit / all / distance bins / per field

decision.sufficient: A1 shadow error <= 0.05 in every channel -> structural hypothesis NOT SUPPORTED; stop the architecture path
decision.proceed: in any channel: A1 shadow error >= 0.10 (persistent) OR e_coll shadow >= 0.05 (irreducible) -> Gate 2

gate2.rule: ONE mechanism chosen from the Gate 1 failure; its specification (discarded information, retained information, complexity, target relations, query / storage budget, failure condition) is committed as an amendment BEFORE any candidate evaluation

conditions.B0: existing aggregation (A0 quadrature and A1 relaxed fit)
conditions.B1: candidate at <= the existing per-receiver feature budget (224 per channel)
conditions.B2: candidate at <= 2x budget, only if needed for the trade-off

gate2.fixed: same fields, receivers, oracle, support (r < 30 cm), metrics, channel treatment; no reference value at inference
gate2.decision: proceed to Gate 3 only if B1 (same fit type as B0) reduces the primary shadow error by >= 25 % relative in at least two channels AND by >= 0.05 absolute in at least one, vs B0 of the same fit type

arms.L0: existing features, learned shared weight network
arms.L1: candidate features, identical network / objective / budget

gate3.network: per element weight w = softplus(MLP_3x64(element geometry in the receiver frame: offset / R_MID, |offset| / R_MID, receiver normal, source normal, element area / reference area, channel-independent) -> 3 channels) x element measure; prediction = sum_elements w * element field feature; linear in the field
gate3.training: target y_S30 on fit fields x fit receivers; loss = per-channel relative MSE (normalised by the target energy of the batch); Adam lr 1e-3, 4000 steps, batch 64 receivers x 32 fields, cosine decay; seeds 4911 / 4912; identical for L0 / L1; no change after inspection
gate3.evaluation: fit / held-out receivers x val / test fields; shadow, distance bins, per channel, per field; parameter count; time
gate3.fair_state: both arms must reach a validation plateau (last-10 % loss change < 2 %) or the comparison is INCONCLUSIVE
gate3.decision: L1 better than L0 on held-out receivers x test fields shadow error by >= 15 % relative in >= 2 channels for both seeds

gate4.real_scene: held-out T0 / T1 views, Yellow pixels, first_r1 references (WL45 test views 8-15 for metrics; s_c from views 0-7): prediction = s_c * (arm in-support response at the pixel + shared oracle > 30 cm tail); arms L0 / L1 / oracle; K44 K_only (historical, camera readout) as a reference
metrics: display PSNR (ldr3) Yellow lit / shadow / 3-30 cm
linear rel L2, radiance ratio, corr
T0 -> T1 Yellow change corr / slope

Atom collisions R 0.015, G 0.069, B 0.225: within-aggregate resolution loss is irreducible for B (and G); for R the information is present inside the aggregates, but even optimised weights stay at 0.56 -> the binding loss for R is the representative SUB-SELECTION (96 of the band aggregates within 5 cm, 128 of the ~1,150 cells within 30 cm), whose unread regions no function of the features observes. A descriptive coverage diagnostic (share of the in-support response carried by sources inside represented aggregates / cells) is computed in Gate 2.

candidate.name: DASQ - receiver-centred distance-adaptive source quadrature
candidate.discards_old: (i) every source outside the 96 / 128 represented aggregates (stratified sub-selection), (ii) intra-aggregate structure below 1.5 cm (band) / 8 cm (mid) regardless of distance
candidate.retains: a per-receiver partition of the WHOLE in-support source set (every Lego port with r < 30 cm, self excluded) into elements whose size grows with distance (octree node accepted when its cell half-diagonal <= alpha x distance to its area-weighted centroid and it lies fully inside or outside the support; straddling nodes are refined; leaves are single ports); element feature = area-mean field (prefix sums over a Morton-ordered port list)
candidate.complexity: element count ~ (2 pi / alpha^2) ln(R_MID / r_min) per surface sheet (logarithmic in range); per field O(elements) via prefix sums; construction = vectorised octree traversal per receiver
candidate.targets: all in-support source-receiver relations, near (< 1.5 cm, B / G) and 5-30 cm (R)
candidate.budget: B1 alpha = the smallest of {0.25, 0.35, 0.5, 0.7, 1.0} whose 95th-percentile element count over the fit receivers <= 224 (the existing 96 + 128); B2 = the smallest with q95 <= 448; chosen from counts only (no response)
candidate.unchanged: support 30 cm, object scope, oracle, fields, receivers, channels, metrics, global / tail
candidate.fit_types: same as B0: ideal-weight quadrature (exact member-average kernel per element, primary), A1v (validation ridge) and A1nn (nonnegative LS init = ideal weights)
candidate.failure_condition: B1 does not meet the Gate 2 decision rule against B0 of the same fit type (primary: ideal-weight quadrature; also reported for the A1* type)
